summary: Work management platform for planning and tracking team tasks and projects.
access_note: Personal access tokens from the developer console; OAuth apps for multi-user use.

evidence.quote: A personal access token (PAT) is the quickest and simplest way to authenticate in the API.
This is the best choice if multiple users need to sign in to your app.
Limits are based on minute-long windows and differ depending on whether the domain is free or paid
To begin making requests against the REST API, see the quick start guide.
The Asana MCP V2 server is available at: https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp

notes: Legacy beta MCP (mcp.asana.com/sse) shuts down 05/11/2026; v2 is current. Free domains are rate limited at 150 req/min per the rate-limit page.

review.reason: Old access quote said nothing about free accounts; the others were not word for word.
